base_policy: Cog-WM LHMM: Xiaomi-Robotics-1-5B with our 1-epoch Human300 SFT checkpoint (56849 updates), frozen during agentic evaluation
notes: Cog-Harness (previously submitted as XR1-Harness). Historical result submitted for Agentic scope and reproducibility review, not a claim of compliance with the current observation-only rules. Run full2500-sft1-astra-memory-20261022-v4: pretrain scenes, 50 tasks x 50 trials, native task horizons; 1765/2500 successes (70.60% overall), versus the historical SFT baseline of 1625/2500 (65.00%). Planner: OpenAI gpt-6-astra, medium reasoning, accessed through local ChatGPT authentication. System: fixed Cog-WM LHMM policy (our Xiaomi-Robotics-1-5B SFT checkpoint), SenseNova-derived motion/perception tools and frozen same-task seed-0 experience from a different VLA. Memory: 43 tasks / 111 payload files, including 9 Composite-Unseen tasks; no online cross-episode memory updates. Source: RLinf/RPent-memory@551fc3157b3e56b40a3d3a3b4c7ff81721ebe89b via sensenova/SenseNova-RoboRSI-Packages@e977b5ad667b4ce753ee947cbb0b95d4fc0fe98c. These inputs require an explicit scope decision under the current rules; we request guidance on acceptance, categorization, or a restricted-observation rerun. Baseline VLA RNG was not recorded, so the aggregate +5.6 percentage points does not isolate a causal memory effect.
